trap.label: tempo verbal
trap.wrong: Supporters argued that the project will create jobs.
trap.right: Supporters argued that the project would create jobs.
trap.why: Português mantém o futuro em discurso indireto; em inglês recua para would.

fix.wrong: Opponents warned it will block traffic.
fix.right: Opponents warned it would block traffic.
Supporters argued it would create jobs.

rewrite.prompt: Discurso indireto: Supporters said, “It will create jobs.” (argued that)
rewrite.answer: Supporters argued that it would create jobs.
